messages:
Maya (AE): FYI ACME legal replied. They listed a few hard blockers for the POC: signed DPA with SCCs, completed SIG/CAIQ (they asked for the "latest"), explicit data deletion/DSAR flow, and a retention policy for logs/PII. They said no kickoff until these are clarified.

Chris (Security Eng): Understood. I can export our CAIQ answers and SOC2 summary. Which SIG version did they reference? v3 or v4?

Maya (AE): Email said "latest" 1st-century legal speak2  assume v4. Need something to send before next Tue kickoff.

Leo (Privacy): On DPA deletions: propose language that says primary data removed within 30 days, logs/backups purged within 90 days, and immediate deletion of identified Personal Data on customer request (documented). Also confirm we support data portability (JSON export) and a DSAR SLA (we usually target 30 days).

Sara (Solutions Eng): Tech details we can commit to for the POC sandbox:
- deletion API: POST /v1/customers/{customer_id}/delete -> returns job_id
- async worker handles object removal and marks job complete
- default retention: 7d for sandbox pseudonymized data, 30d for normal customer objects, 90d for infra logs/backups
We can run the POC on a dedicated namespace if they require stronger isolation.

Devon (Presales): Heads-up: dedicated namespace + faster retention (immediate purge on request) will change the cost estimate. I'll add a dedicated-capacity + data-isolation line in the SOW and present two pricing tiers.

Chris (Security Eng): I'll generate the CAIQ CSV export and attach SOC2 summary and a subprocessors list. Also call out encryption-at-rest (KMS) and TLS in flight, and our key rotation cadence for private deployments.

Leo (Privacy): Draft DPA deletion clause we can send to ACME legal: 

```
Data Deletion: Upon Customer's written request, Redwood Inference will permanently delete Customer Data from production storage within thirty (30) days. System logs and backups containing Customer Data will be purged within ninety (90) days, except as required by applicable law. Customer may request immediate deletion of specific Personal Data elements, which Redwood will execute within a commercially reasonable timeframe and record in an audit log.
```

Maya (AE): That looks good. Chris  can you attach the CAIQ export + SOC2 summary to this thread by EOD? Also confirm subprocessors addendum availability.

Chris (Security Eng): Will do. Uploaded links: https://redwood.internal/sig-exports/acme-caic-v4.csv and https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2-summary-acme.pdf. Subprocessors addendum yes, we can share a redline.

Sara (Solutions Eng): Proposed POC plan (minimize legal friction):
Phase A - Sandbox (7d retention, pseudonymized inputs, no embeddings or mask if possible)
Phase B - Full POC (30d retention, dedicated namespace, optional embedding masking)
This lets them kick the evaluation without waiting on SCC execution.

Devon (Presales): I'll draft a two-phase SOW with pricing deltas for isolation and masking. Will include a one-time data isolation/setup fee and an optional dedicated-capacity monthly estimate.

Maya (AE): Action list:
- Maya: confirm SIG version with ACME legal (today)
- Chris: CAIQ export + SOC2 + subprocessors addendum (EOD)
- Leo: finalize DPA text + DSAR SLA (tomorrow)
- Sara: sandbox retention/runbook (tomorrow)
- Devon: two-phase SOW + pricing (tomorrow AM)

Chris (Security Eng): Quick note: if they insist on SCCs executed in agreement rather than annex, legal will need our SCC annex and subprocessors redline. I'll flag to Legal Ops.

Maya (AE): I'll update the customer and post their counsel reply here. If they push for immediate deletion during the sandbox we should escalate the dedicated namespace option. :thumbsup:

Leo (Privacy): Also flagging re-identification risk for embeddings. Recommend pseudonymization for inputs and only enable embeddings masking for production with a stronger NDA or contractual guarantee.

Sara (Solutions Eng): Agreed. For metrics we can pseudonymize identifiers and keep evaluation metrics intact. Embedding masking is more invasive and will add time.

Devon (Presales): Noted I'll price both options.

Maya (AE): Closing loop  will post ACME's reply when it arrives.
